about.title: About AlHeba International
about.body: Established in 1989, Al-Heba International Trading and Marketing EST. is a distinguished name in the iron and metal trade field across Egypt and the Middle East. With origins rooted in deep industry experience, we are dedicated to both the importation and exportation of high-quality iron products. Our extensive network allows us to act as agents for some of the most prominent Arabian companies and factories, facilitating trade throughout the Arab world and beyond, including markets in Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Emirates, Kuwait, Sudan, Yemen, Libya, Turkey, and Tunisia. We pride ourselves on selecting international factories of the highest standards to maintain our reputation for excellence and uniqueness in the market.

story.section1: The journey of Al-Heba begins with the vision of Eng. Ismail Ahmed Aly. Having served as the General Manager for one of the largest iron and metal companies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, he brought a wealth of experience to his own venture. In the mid-1980s, the concept of exporting Egyptian iron products abroad took hold, leading to the formal establishment of Al-Heba International Trading and Marketing EST. in 1989.
story.section2: Our initial business focused on exporting iron products to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. We quickly expanded, entering the Jordanian market, and within two years, we were exporting to the Emirates and Kuwait, positioning ourselves as a leading exporting company in Egypt and the region. Our growth trajectory continued as we became agents for major Arabian firms and factories, broadening our reach to Sudan, Yemen, Libya, Turkey, and Tunisia. Over more than a quarter of a century, this expansion has solidifed Al-Heba as a respected name in the Arab iron market. In 2004, we diversified our operations further by entering the field of importing iron products, carefully selecting high-quality international factories to ensure our continued distinction in the industry.

SteelProducts.header: Iron and Steel Exporting and Importing
SteelProducts.description: specializes in a comprehensive range of industrial and construction steel products, covering everything from raw semi-finished stock to precision-engineered long and flat items

rebar.name: Rebar Steel
rebar.description: Deformed steel bars manufactured for concrete reinforcement and structural engineering applications.
highlights: Size Range: 6 mm to 32 mm diameters
Standards: ASTM A615 (Gr 40/60), BS 4449 (1997/2005), GCC/ISO 6935-2
Standard Lengths: 6m, 12m, and 13m bars
High strength, ductility, and weldability via quenching process

billet.name: Billet Steel
billet.description: Square semi-finished steel blocks used as primary feedstock for rerolling into long products.
highlights: Cross-Sections: 130x130 mm and 150x150 mm
Length Range: 3.8m up to 14m (±50mm tolerance)
Carbon Content: 0.40% to 0.93% (Max limits for Si, Mn, P, S)
Strict squareness, straightness, and corner radius tolerances

railway.name: Railway Steel
railway.description: Heavy structural steel rail profiles manufactured for railway networks and industrial tracks.
highlights: Engineered for heavy axle-load rail networks
Specialized profile geometry and high fatigue resistance
Suitable for national transit and industrial crane lines

hrc.name: Hot Rolled Steel Coil (HRC)
hrc.description: Flat steel rolled at high temperatures, supplied in coils or heavy plates for industrial fabrication.
highlights: Supplied in continuous coils and cut-to-length stacked sheets
Ideal for heavy structural framing, pipes, and pressure vessels
High formability and structural toughness

crc.name: Cold Rolled Steel Coil (CRC)
crc.description: Precision ambient-rolled flat steel delivering superior surface finish and tight dimensional tolerances.
highlights: Exceptional surface finish ready for painting and coating
Enhanced mechanical strength and uniform thickness
Used in automotive panels, home appliances, and light framing

galvanized.name: Galvanized Steel Coil
galvanized.description: Zinc-coated steel coils offering ultimate resistance against atmospheric and marine oxidation.
highlights: Protective hot-dip zinc coating layer
Superior anti-corrosion durability for outdoor and humid environments
Widely used in roofing sheets, HVAC ductwork, and panels

scrap.name: Steel Scrap
scrap.description: Sorted heavy industrial steel scrap utilized as direct melting feedstock for electric arc furnaces.
highlights: Primary furnace feedstock for steel mills and foundries
Sorted structural scrap elements for efficient smelting operations
